edit_summary.reason: Convert the repeatable raw per-step action_0_bonus into a one-shot event-gated bonus that is paid only once when the lander first achieves a stable near-pad state with both legs contacting. This prevents farming of the bonus without task completion. Also increase the success_bonus to 300 to make it clearly distinguishable from proxy rewards and provide a stronger terminal signal. Reduce the angle_penalty scale to -0.02 to avoid discouraging necessary orientation engine use. Keep the progress-delta shaping terms as they are, but ensure they are not dominated by diagnostic terms.

crash_penalty as a large terminal penalty
progress_bonus as a one-shot event-gated bonus
changed_design: action_0_bonus: changed from repeatable raw per-step bonus (+0.5 every step when condition met) to one-shot event-gated bonus (+1.0 paid only once when the lander first achieves a stable near-pad state with both legs contacting). This prevents farming without task completion.
success_bonus: increased from 200 to 300 to make it clearly distinguishable from proxy rewards and provide a stronger terminal signal.
angle_penalty: reduced from -0.05*abs(angle) to -0.02*abs(angle) to avoid discouraging necessary orientation engine use.
progress_bonus: kept as one-shot event-gated bonus (+1.0) for achieving stable near-pad state with both legs contacting, but now it is paid before the action_0_bonus and success_bonus.

edit_summary.target_behavior_plan: The revised reward converts the repeatable action_0_bonus into a one-shot event-gated bonus that is paid only once when the lander first achieves a stable near-pad state with both legs contacting. This prevents farming of the bonus without task completion. The success_bonus is increased to 300 to make it clearly distinguishable from proxy rewards and provide a stronger terminal signal. The angle_penalty is reduced to avoid discouraging necessary orientation engine use. The progress-delta shaping terms remain to guide the lander toward the pad.
edit_summary.action_coverage_plan: All discrete actions (0,1,2,3) are already used. The action_0_bonus is converted to a one-shot event-gated bonus, so the policy will still use action 0 when it achieves the stable near-pad state, but it will not farm the bonus repeatedly. The policy must learn to use action 0 during the final approach phase to achieve the one-shot bonus and then the success bonus.
edit_summary.phase_guidance_plan: Phase 1 (descent): The progress-delta shaping encourages the lander to move toward the pad and reduce vertical speed. Phase 2 (final approach): The progress_bonus and action_0_bonus (one-shot) encourage the lander to achieve a stable near-pad state with both legs contacting. Phase 3 (landing): The success_bonus (300) provides a strong terminal signal for completing the task.
edit_summary.payment_mode_plan: The progress-delta shaping is paid every step based on the change in distance and velocity. The progress_bonus is a one-shot event-gated reward paid only once when the lander first achieves a stable near-pad state with both legs contacting. The action_0_bonus is now a one-shot event-gated reward paid only once when the lander first achieves a stable near-pad state with both legs contacting (same condition as progress_bonus, but separate bonus). The success_bonus is a terminal reward paid only on successful termination. The crash_penalty is a terminal penalty paid on failure termination.

components.name: success_bonus
components.description: Large positive reward for a successful landing: both legs contact, |x| < 0.1, |vx| < 0.1, |vy| < 0.1, |angle| < 0.1 radians.

components.name: progress_bonus
components.description: One-shot bonus for achieving a stable near-pad state with both legs contacting. Paid only once per episode.

components.name: action_0_bonus
components.description: One-shot bonus for achieving a stable near-pad state with both legs contacting. Paid only once per episode. Replaces the previous repeatable raw per-step bonus.

components.name: distance_progress
components.description: Progress-delta feedback based on change in horizontal distance to pad. Positive when moving closer, negative when moving away.

components.name: vertical_speed_progress
components.description: Progress-delta feedback based on change in absolute vertical speed. Positive when slowing down, negative when speeding up.

components.name: angle_penalty
components.description: Negative reward proportional to absolute angle to encourage upright orientation.

components.name: fuel_penalty_main
components.description: Small negative reward for using main engine to encourage fuel efficiency.

components.name: fuel_penalty_side
components.description: Small negative reward for using side engines to encourage fuel efficiency.

components.name: crash_penalty
components.description: Large negative reward for crashing (terminated without success).

reward_code:
def compute_reward(self, state, m_power, s_power, terminated):
    # Extract state variables
    x = state[0]
    y = state[1]
    vx = state[2]
    vy = state[3]
    angle = state[4]
    angular_velocity = state[5]
    leg1_contact = state[6]
    leg2_contact = state[7]

    # Initialize diagnostic variables
    distance_to_pad = 0.0
    vertical_speed = 0.0
    angle_deviation = 0.0
    fuel_usage = 0.0
    success_flag = 0.0
    crash_flag = 0.0
    progress_bonus_flag = 0.0
    action_0_bonus_flag = 0.0
    distance_progress_value = 0.0
    vertical_speed_progress_value = 0.0

    # Compute distance to pad (horizontal distance)
    distance_to_pad = abs(x)

    # Compute vertical speed magnitude
    vertical_speed = abs(vy)

    # Compute angle deviation from upright
    angle_deviation = abs(angle)

    # Compute fuel usage
    fuel_usage = m_power + s_power

    # Initialize reward components
    success_bonus = 0.0
    progress_bonus = 0.0
    action_0_bonus = 0.0
    distance_progress = 0.0
    vertical_speed_progress = 0.0
    angle_penalty = 0.0
    fuel_penalty_main = 0.0
    fuel_penalty_side = 0.0
    crash_penalty = 0.0

    # Check for success: both legs contact, near pad, low velocities, upright
    both_legs_contact = (leg1_contact == 1.0 and leg2_contact == 1.0)
    near_pad = (abs(x) < 0.1)
    low_vx = (abs(vx) < 0.1)
    low_vy = (abs(vy) < 0.1)
    upright = (abs(angle) < 0.1)

    if both_legs_contact and near_pad and low_vx and low_vy and upright:
        success_bonus = 300.0
        success_flag = 1.0

    # Progress bonus: one-shot for achieving stable near-pad state with both legs contacting
    # Use internal state to track if already given
    if not hasattr(self, '_progress_bonus_given'):
        self._progress_bonus_given = False
    if not self._progress_bonus_given:
        if both_legs_contact and near_pad and low_vx and low_vy and upright:
            progress_bonus = 1.0
            progress_bonus_flag = 1.0
            self._progress_bonus_given = True

    # Action 0 bonus: one-shot for achieving stable near-pad state with both legs contacting
    # Use internal state to track if already given
    if not hasattr(self, '_action_0_bonus_given'):
        self._action_0_bonus_given = False
    if not self._action_0_bonus_given:
        if both_legs_contact and near_pad and low_vx and low_vy and upright:
            action_0_bonus = 1.0
            action_0_bonus_flag = 1.0
            self._action_0_bonus_given = True

    # Distance progress: delta of abs(x) compared to previous step
    if not hasattr(self, '_prev_abs_x'):
        self._prev_abs_x = abs(x)
    prev_abs_x = self._prev_abs_x
    current_abs_x = abs(x)
    delta_abs_x = current_abs_x - prev_abs_x
    # Positive reward for moving closer (delta negative), negative for moving away
    distance_progress = -0.5 * delta_abs_x
    self._prev_abs_x = current_abs_x

    # Vertical speed progress: delta of abs(vy) compared to previous step
    if not hasattr(self, '_prev_abs_vy'):
        self._prev_abs_vy = abs(vy)
    prev_abs_vy = self._prev_abs_vy
    current_abs_vy = abs(vy)
    delta_abs_vy = current_abs_vy - prev_abs_vy
    # Positive reward for slowing down (delta negative), negative for speeding up
    vertical_speed_progress = -0.5 * delta_abs_vy
    self._prev_abs_vy = current_abs_vy

    # Angle penalty (regularizer)
    angle_penalty = -0.02 * angle_deviation

    # Fuel penalties (regularizers)
    fuel_penalty_main = -0.03 * m_power
    fuel_penalty_side = -0.01 * s_power

    # Crash penalty (if terminated and not success)
    if terminated and success_flag == 0.0:
        crash_penalty = -100.0
        crash_flag = 1.0

    # Total reward
    reward = success_bonus + progress_bonus + action_0_bonus + distance_progress + vertical_speed_progress + angle_penalty + fuel_penalty_main + fuel_penalty_side + crash_penalty

    # Individual reward diagnostics
    individual_reward = {
        'success_bonus': success_bonus,
        'progress_bonus': progress_bonus,
        'action_0_bonus': action_0_bonus,
        'distance_progress': distance_progress,
        'vertical_speed_progress': vertical_speed_progress,
        'angle_penalty': angle_penalty,
        'fuel_penalty_main': fuel_penalty_main,
        'fuel_penalty_side': fuel_penalty_side,
        'crash_penalty': crash_penalty,
        'distance_to_pad': distance_to_pad,
        'vertical_speed': vertical_speed,
        'angle_deviation': angle_deviation,
        'fuel_usage': fuel_usage,
        'success_flag': success_flag,
        'crash_flag': crash_flag,
        'progress_bonus_flag': progress_bonus_flag,
        'action_0_bonus_flag': action_0_bonus_flag
    }

    return float(reward), individual_reward

expected_behavior.expected_action_distribution_change: Action 0 (do nothing) usage may decrease slightly because the per-step bonus is removed, but the one-shot bonus still provides an incentive to use action 0 when achieving the stable near-pad state. The policy should learn to use action 0 during the final approach phase to collect the one-shot bonus and then the success bonus.
expected_behavior.expected_phase_change: Phase 1 (descent): The progress-delta shaping should guide the lander toward the pad. Phase 2 (final approach): The one-shot bonuses (progress_bonus and action_0_bonus) should encourage the lander to achieve a stable near-pad state with both legs contacting. Phase 3 (landing): The success_bonus (300) should provide a strong terminal signal for completing the task.
expected_behavior.expected_target_behavior_change: The success_like_terminal_rate should increase from 0.4 to >=0.5 because the success_bonus is now 300, making it clearly distinguishable from proxy rewards. The timeout_rate should decrease because the policy has a stronger incentive to terminate with success rather than timeout.

known_risks: The one-shot bonuses (progress_bonus and action_0_bonus) may not be sufficient to guide the policy toward the stable near-pad state if the progress-delta shaping is too weak.
The angle_penalty reduction from -0.05 to -0.02 may reduce the incentive to maintain upright orientation, potentially leading to more crashes.
The success_bonus increase to 300 may cause the policy to over-optimize for the terminal condition and ignore fuel efficiency or smoothness.
The removal of the per-step action_0_bonus may cause the policy to stop using action 0 entirely, which could lead to less stable landings.
